Long Task Manager Skill v1.0.0

- Initial release with a complete long-duration task management framework for AI agents.
- Supports non-blocking task submission, real-time progress tracking, cancellation, resume/retry, and persistent state.
- Provides a simple Python API for submitting and monitoring large code generation, data processing, or document creation tasks.
- Enables agents to report progress updates; supports batch management and custom storage backends.
- Includes troubleshooting guide, installation instructions, and integration examples.
